sources.title: Create returns in POS
sources.scope: Original-transaction-linked return processing. The approved retail research ledger records a full official-page fetch on 2026-09-14, including original lookup, return-history freshness and partial-quantity tax sections.
supported_claims: Original transactions can be located using receipt, order, channel reference or invoice identifiers.
Original and previously returned quantities inform the available-to-return quantity limit; return reasons are recorded.
Synchronized offline return quantities can be stale.
Partial return tax handling can preserve originally charged tax.
sources.limitations: This is public product guidance, not a universal return window, condition policy, statutory entitlement or specification of our cumulative penny-allocation algorithm. The nonvalidated Return product operation is excluded. The locally bundled exports do not establish live return availability. Retrieval is inherited from the approved research ledger, not a new live fetch during implementation.

sources.title: Linked refunds of previously approved and confirmed transactions
sources.scope: Linked-refund concept, prerequisites and supported/unsupported flows. The approved retail research ledger records a full official-page fetch on 2026-09-14.
supported_claims: A linked refund refers to a previously approved and confirmed transaction.
A refund can be full or partial and cannot exceed the original authorization.
Execution requires payment configuration and connector capabilities and excludes some exchange, gift-card, receiptless and multi-invoice flows.
sources.limitations: No payment connection, token, account information or authorization to issue money exists here. Confirmation and the single-card reference are synthetic historical evidence only. We also impose a reconciled captured-money cap, whole-unit scope and closed-opening-history rules as conservative sample policy; these are not a complete implementation of Commerce payment processing. Retrieval is inherited from the approved research ledger.
